Explicit seven-day cap disposition, zero/past/short advice, failed-manual preservation, successful operator override, unconditional recovery and independent due-source progress

limits: Synthetic weights verify execution, not pretrained language or retrieval quality
No GPU, full entity resolution/diversity, live cloud provider or remote MCP verification
Runtime executable/model hashes do not attest all libraries or source-to-binary provenance
Privacy scans are a backstop, not an exhaustive anonymity guarantee
This receipt applies to the named code commit; later documentation does not expand its scope
Checkpoint files contain private data and require operator-managed encrypted storage and independent digest custody
Restored unfinished jobs require reconciliation; disabled source rows are not an external-supervisor interlock
Orphan cleanup only: all retained records and their evidence, shared feeds, backups and previously disclosed copies remain; no full erasure or E48 acceptance
Format-1 checkpoints need the previous isolated tool/schema pair; automatic adoption into an existing lifecycle dataset is not implemented
Offline recovery cannot detect joint rollback of policy, digest and trusted minimum-revision receipts
Lifecycle barriers are cooperative and database-scoped; old binaries and privileged direct writers are outside that enforcement claim
GC requires an initially matching database/store pair, current cooperative writers and private plan/journal custody; hostile filesystem mutation and physical media sanitization are outside scope
Orphan deletion can leave a partial irreversible outcome; resume requires the matching durable intent, unchanged policy/reference set and surviving shard directories
Acquisition socket tests use controlled fixture routing; public DNS/TLS interoperability and broader adversarial HTTP acceptance remain incomplete
Redirect-response retry advice, shared-host quotas, jitter, cursors, broader acquisition formats and acquisition-wide acceptance remain pending
Known core-v4 format-2 adoption is tested against its published table/column contract; core-v3/format-1 lineage adoption remains unavailable
Native systemd parsing does not prove service sandbox operation; separately revision-bound manual profile evidence is in profile-diagnostics.json
Public authored synthetic ranking cases do not establish independent semantic quality or a sovereign production model profile
Collector role narrows application SQL authority, not per-source tenancy or OS evidence confidentiality; its writable CAS is not an OS-enforced append-only store
Privilege admission is a startup observation; privileged concurrent grant/schema changes and trusted broad-writer Python callers remain outside containment
Connection timeout applies per host/address attempt, not a strict DNS-wide or whole-command deadline

Reference-service receipt separately establishes synthetic enabled HTTP acquisition, accelerated timer activation, authentication and owned cleanup; Internet DNS/TLS, production cadence and operational deployment remain pending
Server advice is bounded per source to seven days with explicit SOURCE_RETRY_AFTER_CAPPED; this does not fully honour a larger requested minimum or implement shared-host governance

Database/application clock correctness is not attested. A response-to-commit crash can lose uncommitted advice and an unacknowledged commit can leave an unknown outcome; only observed database state establishes persistence

Manual refresh and resource changes override due admission; successful manual refresh resets normal polling, failed manual refresh retains an older later reservation, and restore clears scheduling while disabling sources

Native TLS uses a temporary authored CA added only to the fixture default context, controlled loopback socket routing and a synthetic hostname; production certificate verification remains enabled. This is not public PKI, revocation or operational TLS acceptance

The resolver receive deadline covers complete bounded JSON IPC after process startup. Startup is not independently hard bounded; termination/kill/receiver cleanup can add up to three seconds. OS/libc/NSS allocation before the Python answer cap remains outside this message bound
The manual service receipt verifies normal bounded-JSON resolver use over synthetic HTTP; partial-IPC fault injection and native TLS are separate test evidence, not TLS under systemd

The advisory module is an opt-in normalized observation envelope, not an upstream CVE/OSV/vendor adapter, database-backed domain profile, registry lookup, evidence verifier, CVSS calculator, inventory matcher or exposure/remediation decision. E31/E32 domain acceptance remains open

Advisory numeric admission uses binary64 with a conservative exact decimal-to-shortest-representation lexical rule. Original decimal spelling/offsets and arbitrary precision are not preserved; raw upstream snapshots remain external

The collector-deployment receipt retains its independently tested source revision and wheel. This module-only implementation change did not repeat systemd service acceptance; native installed-wheel regression success does not extend the older manual receipt
